BiblicalUsage: Baara was a wife of Shaharaim the Benjamite, named in the genealogy of Benjamin among his wives Hushim and Baara. She appears once, in the list of the sons born to Shaharaim in the country of Moab.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the genealogies keep wives like Baara because families are built by mothers as much as by fathers, and God counts both.
